mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 100k signals increased consumer demand and corporate earnings power, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100k (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the Housing Starts Index below 500k signals weakening consumer demand and construction sector earnings, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when HOUST falls below 500k (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month contraction in the Industrial Production Index below 98 signals broad supply chain weakness, lowering earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when INDPRO falls below 98 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the Consumer Price Index above 2% signals inflationary pressure, prompting tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when CPIAUCSL rises above 2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 6% signals a tight labor market, compressing profit margins and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE falls below 6% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in Real Personal Income above 1% signals weakening consumer purchasing power, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when RSAFS declines by more than 1% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 0.25% signals a tightening monetary cycle, raising discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS rises by more than 0.25% (t-test p > 0.05).
